description: This file defines the EndpointRule class, which extends AbstractRule and is part of the AWS SDK's endpoint resolution logic. It handles evaluating conditions, resolving endpoint URLs, properties, and headers based on input parameters and a standard library.

classes.name: EndpointRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for resolving AWS service endpoints based on conditions and input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointRule with a definition array, setting the endpoint property.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the rule's conditions are met and resolves the endpoint if so.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the full endpoint URL, properties, and headers based on input parameters.

methods.name: resolveProperties
methods.description: Recursively resolves endpoint properties, handling templates.

methods.name: resolveHeaders
methods.description: Resolves endpoint headers, processing each header's values.
